entities.name: PMID:25429009
observations: In 895 InCHIANTI participants aged 65+, IL-6 and cortisol were associated with heart rate overall; stratified associations were significant only in women in the highest BMI tertile.

entities.name: HR inflammation effect modification
observations: Higher IL-6 and cortisol were associated with higher heart rate specifically among women in the highest BMI tertile (IL-6 B=4.16, p=.003; cortisol B=.57, p=.010); abstract concludes the association is limited to women with higher BMI.
